cursorInstallModal.title: Install CybeDefend in Cursor
cursorInstallModal.description: Cursor does not connect to the Open VSX Registry by default. You need to download the .vsix file and install it manually.

step1.title: Download the .vsix file
step1.description: Go to the Open VSX Registry and download the latest CybeDefend .vsix file.

step2.title: Install the extension
step2.description: Choose one of the following methods to install the extension in Cursor:

optionA.label: Option A: Command Palette
optionA.description: Open the Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P / Cmd+Shift+P), type "Extensions: Install from VSIX..." and select the downloaded file.

step3.title: Configure and scan
step3.description: Select your region, authenticate via OAuth 2.0, configure your project, and start scanning. The workflow is the same as in VS Code.
step3.importDescription: Enter your instance's URL, sign in with a personal access token, choose your project and review the findings imported into it. The workflow is the same as in VS Code.

cursorInstallModal.warningDescription: When a new version of CybeDefend is released, you will need to download and install the updated .vsix file manually. Cursor does not auto-update extensions installed from .vsix files.
